title: Left external Cech cup with prescribed cochain coordinates
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ morphisms of quasi-compact schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $G$ any $\mathcal O_Y$-module. Let $T,P$ be the tensor and product Cech functors of [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-left-cech-exact]. There exists a natural transformation $\theta:T\Rightarrow P$ satisfying the following cochain-coordinate condition, called IsPicardLeftCechCup. For every left module $F$, degrees $p,q\geq0$, factor cochains $a,b$, and product-cover tuple $y=(y_0,\ldots,y_{p+q})$, include the pure tensor of $a,b$ into the $(p,q)$ summand of the total of the extended factor Cech complexes. Apply $\theta_F$ and identify degree $p+q$ of the extended product complex with its natural-index term. Its tuple coordinate is the tensor section of the first-projection pullback of the front cochain coordinate $a_{y_0^X,\ldots,y_p^X}$ and the second-projection pullback of the back coordinate $b_{y_p^Y,\ldots,y_{p+q}^Y}$, restricted to the common product intersection. Pullback uses the canonical tensor-pullback adjunction units [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]; the faces and tensor section are those of [def-sc-cech-cup-product], using the shared section and face constructions of [lem-sc-picard-right-cech-cup-construction]. This statement imposes neither quasi-coherence nor affine-diagonal assumptions, and contains no homology map or comparison.

source.place: Tag 0BED, equation-kunneth-on-cech (33.29.1.1); Cohomology Tags 01FD, 07MB and 0FKV; official tag pages read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED and corresponding tag URLs.

proof.text: Choose a single extended cup component for each left coefficient module using the component theorem. The proved left-coefficient naturality identity makes these maps the components of a natural transformation. Its component predicate is definitionally the original IsPicardLeftCechCup condition, so apply each chosen component coordinate proof. No data definition is filled by an unproved existence theorem.

theorem picardLeftCechCup_exists
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] (G : Y.Modules) :
    ∃ θ : picardLeftTensorCechFunctor f g G ⟶ picardLeftProductCechFunctor f g G,
      IsPicardLeftCechCup f g G θ
